risk_note: RV2 money (withdraw lane, model Claude Fable 5.1): the console write-off of an R2 late-success difference — the Alipay bill shows a transfer as successful while the withdrawal was returned to APPROVED as a payer-side failure (W9) — settling the withdrawal as PAID_API on the stored bill line (08 BR-WDR-23 ③ 决-08 A, BR-WDR-08 W11, BR-WDR-09, BR-WDR-17, BR-FUND-19; contract CT-24za writeOffAdminReconDiff, planned lifted here). payout's createWithdrawalProvenSuccess is the single writer of the withdrawal: switch payout.proven_success_writeoff.enabled (default on) → users row lock → ledger.lockBalances → reread under the locks (not APPROVED → 20902 withdrawal; not payer_side_after_transfer / not exactly one kind=transfer attempt with result fail / the bill line's out_biz_no not the withdrawal's / amount ≠ net_fen → refused with the contract's data.reason) → one CAS to PAID_API (paid_at the bill line's booked time else the clock, channel_order_id from the line, hold cleared, executor the operator) → the W5 voucher WITHDRAW:SUCCESS:CASH_<channel> wd:{id}:PAID (operator admin:<id>) → the attempt-append job queued on the same transaction (orchestrator ruling D10-428: the payout process, couli_payout, appends the kind=query / result=success record idempotently on (withdrawal_id, recon_diff_id); no grant to couli_app) → wallet.withdrawal_changed. ledger's writeOffAdminReconDiff owns the idempotent transaction (Idempotency-Key, subject a:<admin>): body, the diff row FOR UPDATE, 20902 recon_diff when handled, the R2 payer_side_returned proof (bill_line, else bill_row with the diff's own out_biz_no), payout's port, the row to written_off with resolution.w11 and the note, the holds of source recon_diff:<id> released (admin:<id>), the audit recon_diff_write_off; the controller checks payout.execute with the totp step-up through the AdminOperationGuard. New queue payout-attempt-append (exclusive, concurrency 1, payout entry only) in the catalog and plan; the frozen queue plan tests were adjusted in a separate test(spec) commit per D10-415 ① (ledger red_exempt). Not in scope: W10, the query-based W11 path, payout.queue_paused, migrations, grants.
